# UC-0A Testing Files

## Input Files (from data/city-test-files/)
- `test_pune.csv` — 15 complaint rows for Pune city
- `test_kolkata.csv` — 15 complaint rows for Kolkata city
- `test_ahmedabad.csv` — 15 complaint rows for Ahmedabad city

## Output Files (generated by classifier.py)
- `results_pune.csv` — Classification results for Pune complaints
- `results_kolkata.csv` — Classification results for Kolkata complaints
- `results_ahmedabad.csv` — Classification results for Ahmedabad complaints

## Run Commands
```bash
python classifier.py --input ../data/city-test-files/test_pune.csv --output results_pune.csv
python classifier.py --input ../data/city-test-files/test_kolkata.csv --output results_kolkata.csv
python classifier.py --input ../data/city-test-files/test_ahmedabad.csv --output results_ahmedabad.csv
```

## Verification
- All 15 rows classified for each city
- Categories from allowed list: Pothole, Flooding, Streetlight, Waste, Noise, Road Damage, Heritage Damage, Heat Hazard, Drain Blockage, Other
- Priority: Urgent if severity keywords present (injury, child, school, hospital, ambulance, fire, hazard, fell, collapse)
- Reason: One sentence citing specific words from description
- Flag: NEEDS_REVIEW for ambiguous categories, blank otherwise
